title: A machine translation of one entity's words (data/translations/<type>/<id>/<locale>.json)
description: Dinis, 9 November 2026, 19:25 UTC (relayed by conductor@): events first, then articles and company pages, into the 21 cultures of assets/app/i18n.json; stored beside the original, each marked machine-translated with its model and date; the English stays the source of truth. source holds the English the translation was made from and source_sha256 its hash (sha256 of JSON.stringify(source)), so a page can tell a stale translation from a current one; the gate does not fail on staleness (the English changes every day).
